documentee.label: Documented
documentee.desc: Attested by an identified archival source.

recoupee.label: Cross-checked
recoupee.desc: Confirmed by at least two independent sources.

temoignee.label: Witnessed
temoignee.desc: Reported by a direct witness, with no confirming document.

transmise.label: Passed on
transmise.desc: Reported by a relative or third party, not a direct witness.

incertaine.label: Uncertain
incertaine.desc: Sources disagree or the information is partial.

inconnue.label: Unknown
inconnue.desc: The information exists but we have not found it.

home.title: The women of the Fort de Romainville
home.lead: Resisters, hostages, deportees: many women passed through this fort in Les Lilas. This memorial gathers their traces, always showing where each piece of information comes from and what remains unknown.
home.slogan: Dusting off the history of these places
home.treeHelp: Each apple is a woman, hanging from the branch of her arrival at the fort. An empty apple marks a restricted record.
home.treeHint: Hover or select an apple to discover a woman.
home.principlesTitle: A memory honest about what it knows

source.title: Every fact has its source
source.desc: Archives, registers, testimonies: you always know where what you read comes from, and how certain it is.

unknown.title: What is missing is said
unknown.desc: Memory is incomplete. Each record also shows what we do not know yet.

silence.title: Silence is respected
silence.desc: When a person or their family refuses exposure, we only keep the trace of their presence.

sources.title: Our sources and rules
sources.intro: Every piece of information shows where it comes from and how certain it is. Memory is incomplete: we also show what we do not know.
sources.reliabilityLead: Each statement carries one of these levels. They are shown with an icon and a word, never by colour alone.
sources.validationText: Public submissions are checked by the team (authenticity, provenance, historical interest) before anything is published. Every decision is explained.

steps.1: You submit a document or information
steps.2: The team checks its provenance and authenticity
steps.3: The decision is explained, whether positive or not
steps.4: Approved content is published with its source

sources.aiText: AI can help us search, transcribe or link documents. It is neither a source nor an authority: anything produced with its help is checked by a person and labelled as such.
